description: A custom BitmapDrawable subclass that manages reference counts for display and cache states, recycling the bitmap when no longer in use.

classes.name: RecyclingBitmapDrawable
classes.description: A BitmapDrawable that tracks whether it is being displayed or cached, and recycles the bitmap when no longer needed.

methods.name: setIsDisplayed
methods.description: Updates display reference count and marks if it has been displayed; triggers check for recycling.

methods.name: setIsCached
methods.description: Updates cache reference count and triggers check for recycling.

methods.name: checkState
methods.description: Recycles the bitmap if it is no longer displayed or cached and has been displayed before.

methods.name: hasValidBitmap
methods.description: Checks if the bitmap exists and is not already recycled.
